+                $expectation = new Expectation($self, $method);\n

+    public function mockery_returnValueForMethod($name)\n
+    {\n
+        $rm = $this->mockery_getMethod($name);\n
+\n
+        if ($rm === null) {\n
+            return null;\n
+        }\n
+\n
+        $returnType = Reflector::getSimplestReturnType($rm);\n
+\n
+        switch ($returnType) {\n
+            case null:     return null;\n
+            case 'string': return '';\n
+            case 'int':    return 0;\n
+            case 'float':  return 0.0;\n
+            case 'bool':   return false;\n
+            case 'true':   return true;\n
+            case 'false':   return false;\n
+\n
+            case 'array':\n
+            case 'iterable':\n
+                return [];\n
+\n
+            case 'callable':\n
+            case '\Closure':\n
+                return static function () : void {\n
+                };\n

+            case '\Traversable':\n
+            case '\Generator':\n
+                $generator = static function () {\n
+                    yield;\n

+            case 'void':\n
+                return null;\n

+            case 'static':\n
+                return $this;\n

+            case 'object':\n

+                if ($this->_mockery_ignoreMissingRecursive) {\n
+                    $mock->shouldIgnoreMissing($this->_mockery_defaultReturnValue, true);\n
+                }\n

+                    $mock->shouldIgnoreMissing($this->_mockery_defaultReturnValue, true);\n
+                }\n

+        }\n
